maintainer: Example entries by the convener; to be reviewed by a Hawaiʻi host
notes: Hawaiʻi has no city or town governments. The counties are the only local governments.
Hawaiʻi has one statewide school system, so there are no local school boards.
Places like Haʻikū-Pauwela are census areas for statistics, not governments.
sources: State of Hawaiʻi Data Book: "Separate municipal governments do not exist"

state_offices.name: Governor and state departments
state_offices.seat: Governor and lieutenant governor, elected statewide; department heads appointed
state_offices.how: State departments, such as the Department of Agriculture and Biosecurity, hold public hearings on proposed rules. A later version could submit common ground there.

state_offices.name: Office of Hawaiian Affairs
state_offices.seat: 9 trustees elected by all registered voters: 4 at large and 5 island seats
state_offices.how: Its board sets policy within its role and could receive packages on those issues.

state_offices.name: Board of Education
state_offices.seat: 9 members appointed by the governor with Senate consent
state_offices.how: Runs the one statewide school system and takes public testimony at its meetings.

state_offices.name: State courts
state_offices.seat: Judges appointed by the governor from a judicial selection commission list
state_offices.how: Courts decide cases. Civic Accord never sends anything to a court.

15009.name: Maui County Council
15009.seat: 9 members; every voter in the county votes for all 9, and each seat has a residency area
15009.note: You vote for all 9 seats wherever you live in the county.
15009.exampleNote: Haʻikū is in the Makawao-Haʻikū-Pāʻia residency area.

15009.name: Mayor and county departments
15009.how: County departments take public comment on plans and rules.

15005.name: Kalawao County
15005.seat: No elected local government; run by the state Department of Health
15005.how: Residents here take part through state and federal deliberations.

school.name: Hawaiʻi State Department of Education
school.seat: The only school district in the state, overseen by the appointed Board of Education
